title: Extract repeated MaterialApp/ProviderScope pump boilerplate in bulk_mark_screen_test.dart and empty_login_ws2_test.dart
why: No shared pumpApp test helper exists anywhere in the repo (a grep of test/helpers/ finds none), so TQ-3 has nothing to point tests at yet. bulk_mark_screen_test.dart hand-rolls the identical ProviderScope+MaterialApp+localizationsDelegates block 5 times in one file. empty_login_ws2_test.dart duplicates it 2 more times even though the same file already defines a _wrapWithProviders helper that isn't reused for those 2 tests. Every AppLocalizations delegate or supported-locale change has to be hand-edited at each duplicate site.
recommendation: Add a shared test/helpers/pump_app.dart with a pumpApp(tester, child, {overrides, locale}) helper; migrate bulk_mark_screen_test.dart's 5 sites onto it and repoint empty_login_ws2_test.dart's 2 stray sites onto the file's own _wrapWithProviders.
acceptance_criteria: bulk_mark_screen_test.dart contains a single MaterialApp construction (via a helper), not 5
empty_login_ws2_test.dart's 2 profile-creation tests use _wrapWithProviders like the rest of the file
